# Bundles

Operator bundles of the catalogs in [`testdata/catalogs`](../catalogs/README.md).

The suite builds an image for every directory here when it starts, and pushes
it to its origin registry as `${ORIGIN_REGISTRY}/oc-mirror/oc-mirror-dev:<directory>`.
Nothing is published: to change a bundle, edit its files and run the tests. The
catalogs that list the bundle are rendered from the new files.

A directory has the layout of a bundle image: `manifests`, with the
ClusterServiceVersion and the CRDs of the operator, and `metadata`, with
`annotations.yaml` and the optional `dependencies.yaml`. Like the bundle
Dockerfiles generated by operator-sdk, the image is these two directories on top
of an empty image, labeled with the annotations. Bundles are built for
`linux/amd64` as Docker schema 2 images, or as an OCI index for the bundles
listed in `multiArchFixtures` (`origin_registry_helpers_test.go`). They are
signed with the test cosign key in `testdata/keys`.

The manifests can refer to the images built by the suite with the placeholders
described in [`testdata/catalogs`](../catalogs/README.md). Every bundle refers to
the operand of [`testdata/operands`](../operands/README.md) by digest:

```yaml
image: ${ORIGIN_REGISTRY}/oc-mirror/oc-mirror-dev@${DIGEST:oc-mirror/oc-mirror-dev:operand}
```

## Operators

* `foo`: the Foo operator reacts to Foos objects. Its bundles depend on `bar`.
* `bar`: the Bar operator reacts to Bars objects.
* `baz`: the Baz operator reacts to Bazs objects.

The icons of their ClusterServiceVersions are `foo.svg`, `bar.svg` and `baz.svg`.

`foo-bundle-v0.3.1-multi` and `bar-bundle-v1.0.0-multi` are copies of
`foo-bundle-v0.3.1` and `bar-bundle-v1.0.0`, built for `linux/amd64` and
`linux/arm64` for `test-catalog-multi`.
